jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/d), you will support recruiting activities for Gas Services while partnering closely with business leaders, HR Business Partners, and a global Talent Acquisition network. Beyond leading day-to-day recruiting operations, you will drive recruiting projects, mentor recruiters, and continuously improve recruiting efficiency and delivery. This role offers a long-term career path with the opportunity to grow into a broader Talent Acquisition leadership position within Gas Services as organizational responsibilities evolve.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Strategic partnership with business leaders and hiring managers across a complex global matrix organization to develop and execute recruiting strategies aligned with business priorities
* Operational leadership and coaching of project teams, ensuring effective workload allocation, capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery against KPIs and service level expectations
* Leadership of Talent Acquisition projects and support of organizational transformation and continuous improvement initiatives across the global Talent Acquisition organization
* Analysis of recruiting metrics and market insights to identify optimization opportunities and drive data-informed decisions that enhance recruiting effectiveness and process excellence
* End-to-end management of recruiting activities across a broad range of functions and position levels, including both tariff and non-tariff roles, while ensuring an outstanding candidate and hiring manager experience
* Close collaboration with HR, Works Councils, business leaders, and global stakeholders to provide guidance on recruiting processes, governance, labor relations, and talent acquisition strategies

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
* Extensive Talent Acquisition experience with a strong end-to-end recruiting generalist background, ideally gained within a global industrial or corporate environment
* Proven experience leading recruiting projects and successfully navigating complex matrix organizations with multiple stakeholder groups
* Strong project management skills and experience driving recruiting or organizational transformation initiatives.
* High data affinity with the ability to interpret recruiting metrics, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions using applicant tracking systems and recruiting analytics
* Sound understanding of collective bargaining agreements (tariff structures), experience collaborating with Works Councils, and familiarity with governance processes in a corporate environment
* Professional proficiency in German and English

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Associate Installer Support Engineer (Spanish Speaking) - (m/w/d) - Fixed Term Contract (Techniker/in - Elektrotechnik (ohne Schwerpunkt)/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Please submit your CV in English in order to be considered for the role.This role is available in Manchester, Amsterdam, and Berlin.This is a 12-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension.The Installer Support team serves as an escalation point for our network of channel partners who distribute, install and service residential Tesla energy products. We strive to empower our channel partners to provide the best end-customer experience possible, and we are an endpoint for determining next steps and solutions for many situations.Installer Support Engineering Technicians offer real-time diagnostics and solutions for trained on-site technicians during installation and maintenance of Tesla’s residential solar, storage and home charging energy products. Strong candidates for this role will already have knowledge in the residential energy industry. Applicants should expect to become a subject matter expert (SME) with Tesla’s energy products with the ability to remotely access and troubleshoot equipment.This is an exciting, fast-paced and rewarding role, and a fantastic opportunity to dig deep into our innovative products while collaborating with some of the most talented people in the world!

What You’ll Do

- Provide top-tier support for live on-site or off-site technical issues regarding residential energy products via phone, chat, email or other channels
- Follow best practices in case handling, follow-up, and documenting interactions and work performed with great detail
- Become highly knowledgeable in the technical operation and complexities of Tesla’s energy products
- Understand and troubleshoot proprietary power electronics systems and their supporting components
- Read and understand single-line diagrams as they pertain to PV and storage systems as well as load and meter component placement
- Review operational logs in proprietary and non-proprietary applications
- Identify trending issues, collect information and report findings to leadership and engineering teams
- Identify process and knowledge gaps and submit feedback that leads to better training and resources
- Become a subject matter expert (SME) in residential Tesla energy products.
- Utilise software including Linux environments, SSH, and more for advanced troubleshooting

What You’ll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in a technical or engineering field, or a minimum of 2+ years’ experience in a technician role
- Fluency in English and Spanish is required for this role 
- Ability to independently make decisions and solve problems with limited direction
- Outstanding written and verbal interpersonal communication skills
- Experience and understanding of customer service, technical support and engineering environments
- Ability to document interactions and steps clearly, accurately and with detail
- Ability to prioritize workflows effectively according to multiple criteria
- Understanding of electrical theory and experience with emphasis on AC/DC power systems or other electronic systems, devices and components
- Experience troubleshooting metering and communications issues involving many variables
- Understanding of commercial electrical metering, energy flow, power factor, and phase rotation
- Electrical engineering knowledge and/or experience is a plus

HR Coordinator

International SOS is the world’s leading medical and security services company with over 12,000 employees working in 1,000 locations in 90 countries. International SOS Government Services administers the TRICARE Overseas Program providing high-quality, accessible health care services for U.S. Military service members, family members, retirees, and other eligible beneficiaries overseas.

About the role

Stuttgart, Germany | Hybrid working – two days from home

Join International SOS Government Services and play a key role in supporting the people behind the TRICARE Overseas Program; an international healthcare program serving military communities overseas.

As the HR point of contact for our Stuttgart office, you will partner with managers and employees across Germany and the wider region, providing trusted advice throughout the employee lifecycle.

Key responsibilities

- Act as the first point of contact for HR matters in Stuttgart, building trusted relationships with employees, managers and senior leaders
- Provide practical guidance on employee relations, performance management, probation, contract changes, rewards, investigations, mediation, disciplinary processes and terminations
- Deliver a welcoming and engaging onboarding experience, including induction presentations and follow-up evaluations
- Work with colleagues to validate monthly payroll changes and ensure information is accurate and submitted on time
- Review HR data, metrics and workforce trends to provide useful insights and support business decisions
- Contribute to HR and organisational development projects across European operations
- Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, solve problems and make services more effective
- Manage sensitive HR correspondence with professionalism, accuracy and discretion

About you

- 3–5 years of HR experience, ideally in a multicultural, matrix organisation
- Strong HR operations, coordination and advisory experience
- Good knowledge of German employment law and Works Council collaboration
- Excellent communication, relationship-building and organisational skills
- Confidence working independently and managing multiple priorities
- Fluent German and English
- MS Office 365 and HRIS experience; SuccessFactors or ADP would be an advantage
- Professional HR certification is desirable but not essential

Occasional travel within the EU may be required.

Ready to make an impact in a fast-moving international healthcare programme? Join TRICARE and help create an exceptional employee experience for the teams delivering essential support across Europe.

By joining International SOS, you will contribute to a global network dedicated to protecting people and organisations. We offer a dynamic and respectful workplace where expertise, innovation, and collaboration drive our success. International SOS has been awarded as a Top Employer in the UK by the Top Employer’s Institute (TEI) for 2025.

13,000 experts | 1,200+ locations | 90 countries | 110+ languages

Start your journey with us today. Apply now!

jobs.occupation: Inside Sales Executive (f/m/d) (Kaufmann/-frau - Spedition und Logistikdienstleistung)
jobs.description:
Welcome to Rhenus!

The Rhenus Group is one of the leading global logistics service providers. Across the entire supply chain, we offer tailored solutions for companies from a wide range of industries. From multimodal transportation and optimal warehousing to seamless customs clearance and innovative value-added services, we stay at the forefront of industry developments and work closely alongside our customers every step of the way.

What you can expect

- In your role, you will proactively contact potential customers by phone and email, qualify leads using CRM systems, and manage opportunities through to handover or direct quotation.
- You will prepare and follow up on tailored offers, including follow-up calls, while working closely with the field sales, tender management, and pricing team to develop suitable logistics solutions.
- You will maintain accurate customer data in the CRM and support the planning and implementation of sales campaigns, mailings, and trade fair participation.
- You will participate in internal sales meetings to align on customer targeting and strategies, while continuously monitoring the market and competitors for new business opportunities.
- Additionally, you will qualify inbound leads from marketing activities and prepare basic pricing calculations to support a smooth and efficient sales process.

What you bring

- You have successfully completed a commercial training, ideally in the field of freight forwarding or logistics services.
- First experience in inside sales or operational air / sea freight is an advantage.
- Naturally, you enjoy speaking with customers and have strong communication skills, especially over the phone.
- A structured and goal-oriented mindset defines your way of working, and you are able to work independently.
- You are confident using MS Office and CRM systems. German fluency is essential, and English skills are beneficial.

Your benefits:

- Agile Environment: Embrace a dynamic work culture, where you and your team adapt quickly to meet evolving needs.
- Events: From team outings to holiday parties and networking events, we build strong connections by spending quality time together.
- Exclusive Discounts: Enjoy exclusive perks: Our extensive partner network gives you access to special discounts with various providers.
- Flat Hierarchies: Get straight through to the decision-makers with our streamlined organizational structure.
- Monthly Gift Vouchers: Enjoy an extra amount each month for fuel, groceries, or entertainment.
- Personalized Growth: Accelerate your career with development opportunities, tailored to your talents and interests.

Through our platforms "kaufDA" and "MeinProspekt" in Germany, and “Bonial” in France, we connect millions of users with their favorite shops and brands—driving real impact every single day.

We are in the midst of an exciting growth phase, scaling fast and transforming the way people discover retail. At Bonial, we thrive in a high-performance, fast-paced environment fueled by motivated, results-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. If you’re looking to be part of a dynamic team that’s shaping the future of retail, we’d love to meet you.bonial welcomes both full- and part-timers!

We are looking for a CRM Manager France (f/m/x) to drive customer engagement, retention, and campaign performance for the French market. As CRM Manager France, you will be responsible for planning, creating, and optimizing CRM campaigns for Bonial France across our app and email channels. You will work with channels such as push notifications, in-app messages, and email newsletters to help users discover the best local offers, brochures, retailers, and products.In this role, you will be part of a collaborative CRM team working across kaufDA, MeinProspekt, and Bonial. You will take ownership of CRM activities for the French market while actively exchanging ideas, learnings, and best practices with your teammates to develop impactful campaigns and improve how we engage and retain our users. You will work closely with Operations, Marketing, Design, Sales, Product, and other stakeholders to deliver relevant, high-quality campaigns that support both user needs and business goals.

We offer:

A high-impact CRM role with responsibility for the French market and direct influence on user engagement and retention.The opportunity to work on well-known consumer apps and email channels that help millions of shoppers discover local offers, brochures, products, and retailers.A collaborative international environment with close interaction between CRM, Marketing, Operations, Design, Sales, and Product.The chance to work with modern CRM tools such as Braze and further develop our personalization, automation, and lifecycle marketing activities.A flexible working model, modern office benefits, regular team events, and opportunities for personal and professional development.The opportunity to shape how Bonial communicates with users in France and contribute to relevant, helpful, and engaging user experiences across our CRM channels.Your tasksYou plan, create, and optimize CRM campaigns for the French market across push notifications, in-app messages, and email.You take ownership of the French campaign calendar and ensure campaigns are delivered on time & with high quality.You think beyond campaign execution and are motivated to proactively drive initiatives that improve user engagement, retention, and the overall user experience. High growth story - Bonial is a high-growth and dynamic company with continuous potential into the future. jobs.description:
Essential Job Functions

- Assist customers in planning, configuring, and selecting appropriate systems.
- Prepare technical quotations and application-specific solution concepts in close collaboration with Sales and Product Management
- Conduct customer training, presentations, and workshops for users
- Attend trade shows to market our products together with Sales
- Provide marketing material (photos, brochures, manuals etc.)
- Provide technical application consultation and support to national and international customers in physiological and cardiological as well as respiratory research applications, with a focus on anesthesia and isolated organ systems of laboratory animals (for example Langendorff or EVLP Ex-Vivo Lung Perfusion modelsl)
- Analyze and resolve technical and application-related issues in-house and at customer sites
- Manage incoming customer claims in collaboration with production, purchasing, R&D and product management
- Support the production team in the assembly and preparation of systems to ensure optimal performance and quality
- Test, inspect, and perform final preparation of systems before shipment, including quality assurance and functional verification
- Install systems on-site at customer facilities, both domestically and abroad
- Provide feedback from customer applications to R&D and contribute to product improvement
- Document customer feedback, test results, and technical adjustments to continuously enhance the company's system solutions

 Skills and Abilities required

- Experienced in sales and customer relationship management
- Strong customer orientation and excellent communication skills
- Precise, structured, and self-directed work style
- Technical understanding and keen attention to quality
- Team spirit and ability to collaborate across departments, especially with production and R&D
- Hand-on mentality
- Excellent written and spoken German and English skills

Bonus Skills and Experience

- ~5 years of experience in life sciences or comparable fields
- Solid knowledge of physiological and cardiological measurement systems
- Experience in animal-based experimental research and laboratory processes
- Practical experience with instrumentation, software control systems, and device calibration

Education and Experience and/or equivalent

- University or University of Applied Sciences degree in Medical Engineering, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, or a comparable scientific-technical discipline

Travel:

- Willingness to travel national and international is required
